title: Fog Is Coming
description:
THE NEW HORROR MOD THE FOG IS COMING
1.21.10
body:
The Fog Is Coming — Your Ultimate Minecraft Horror Nightmare

Did you think the Overworld was safe as long as the stars were out? You were wrong. This mod transforms your vanilla survival into an uncompromising, spine-chilling horror experience where every wrong step could be your last. No fog will hide you here — you will have to look your fears right in the eyes.

💀 Key Features:
👤 The Relentless Entity: A terrifying, ancient creature now haunts your world. It doesn't just wander around — it actively stalks you, hides in the shadows, and waits for the perfect moment to strike.

😱 Heart-Stopping Jumpscares: You are never truly safe. A dynamic jumpscare system ensures that you’ll be jumping out of your seat when you least expect it.

🔊 Immersive & Terrifying Audio: The mod completely overhauls the acoustic atmosphere. Chilling ambient tracks, sudden whispers, distant screams, and heavy breathing right behind you will keep you on edge.

🕯️ Paralyzing Atmosphere: A pure sense of dread and helplessness. Familiar caves and nightly forests will now invoke primal fear.

⚠️ WARNING: Playing with headphones in a dark room is highly recommended. If you feel like someone is watching you from the dark... they are.
